data.title: ATP Yazılım ve Teknoloji Terminates Share Buy-Back Program
data.description:
ATP Yazilim ve Teknoloji AS ( (TR:ATATP) ) has issued an announcement.

ATP Yazılım ve Teknoloji A.Ş. terminated its share buy-back program on November 19, 2026, after fully using the TRY 100 million allocation. It repurchased 792,379 shares, equal to 0.845% of share capital, at an average price of TRY 126.20 and a maximum price of TRY 217.31, with an aggregate cost of TRY 99,999,968.6.

During the program, the company disposed of shares with a nominal value of TRY 330,821 at an average price of TRY 144.95, reporting an actual gain/loss of TRY 20,638,468.68. It currently holds 461,558 treasury shares, representing 0.4923% of its share capital.

data.title: SBI Holdings Sets Terms for Zero-Coupon Convertible Bonds Due 2033
data.description:
SBI Holdings ( (JP:8473) ) has shared an update.

SBI Holdings announced the determined terms for its zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2033, which include stock acquisition rights. The exercise contribution amount equals the bonds’ principal amount, while the conversion price was set at ¥3,248, a 15.01% premium to the Tokyo Stock Exchange closing price of ¥2,824 on November 19, 2026.

data.title: Nestmedic Signs Exclusive Polish Distribution Agreement for Pregnabit PRO
data.description:
Nestmedic SA ( (PL:NST) ) has issued an update.

Nestmedic’s Pregnabit PRO devices and Pregnabit Cloud medical analysis system are used for remote cardiotocographic (CTG) monitoring. On 17 November 2026, the company entered an exclusive Polish distribution agreement with TELEKTG covering those products.

The agreement assigns TELEKTG responsibility for sales development, customer acquisition, supply to hospitals, healthcare facilities and other authorized entities, and operation of a 24-hour Obstetric Monitoring Center. It sets five-device monthly deliveries for 24 months, totaling 120, with additional deliveries by separate order. Nestmedic’s management board called the deal important to commercializing Pregnabit PRO and developing a remote CTG devices-and-services model.

data.title: FHH Announces Proposed Anaesthesiology and Dermatology Acquisitions
data.description:
Foundation Healthcare Holdings Limited ( (SG:FHH) ) just unveiled an update.

FHH announced agreements providing for an initial acquisition of 60% of Anaesthesia Connect and The Skin Specialists and Laser Clinic, followed by the acquisition of the remaining 40% of each company. The proposed transactions mark the Group’s entry into dermatology and concern the expansion of its anaesthesia capabilities, broadening its specialist offering and referral network.

The Skin Specialists and Laser Clinic provides medical and surgical dermatology services, while Anaesthesia Connect supports surgical procedures. On an unaudited FY2025 basis, the practices recorded net profits of approximately S$3.1 million and S$1.8 million, respectively; FHH said the acquisitions complement its specialist network and ambulatory surgical infrastructure.

data.title: CVKMD Share-Conversion Notification Listed
data.description:
CVK MADEN ISLETMELERI SANAYI VE TICARET A.S ( (TR:CVKMD) ) just unveiled an update.

The release lists MKK-member notifications concerning the conversion of shares into trading shares under Article 15 of the Capital Markets Board’s Communiqué on Shares. For CVKMD, the listed quantity is 4,790,826 shares; notifications also cover IDGYO, USHOL and YBTAS.

Requests covered by Article 15, paragraph 6, are to be converted on the wholesale transaction settlement date. If shares covered by the memorandum are offered on the exchange, the sale may occur no earlier than the third business day after the memorandum’s PDP announcement.

data.title: HF Sinclair Appoints Shawn Carsten as Chief Financial Officer
data.description:
HF Sinclair Corporation Shs Unsponsored Brazilian Depositary Receipt Repr 1 Sh ( (BR:H1FC34) ) has provided an update.

On November 16, 2026, HF Sinclair’s board appointed Shawn J. Carsten as executive vice president and chief financial officer, effective January 1, 2027. At the time of the announcement, Carsten was serving as vice president of finance and chief financial officer of Golden Pass LNG, a role he had held since 2024, and had previously been chief financial officer of Shell Midstream Partners from 2017 to 2024.

The Compensation Committee approved an annual base salary of $775,000, a 90% target cash incentive capped at 180% for the 2027 performance period, and $2.7 million in long-term incentive awards split equally between performance share units and restricted stock units. Carsten was also set to receive additional restricted stock units valued at $700,000, a $700,000 sign-on bonus and a $60,000 relocation bonus, with specified vesting and repayment conditions; Acting CFO Vivek Garg was to remain vice president, chief accounting officer and controller.

data.title: K2 F&B Holdings Amends Audit Committee Terms of Reference
data.description:
K2 F&B Holdings Limited ( (HK:2108) ) has issued an update.

K2 F&B Holdings Limited amended its Audit Committee terms of reference on 19 November 2026. The framework requires at least three non-executive members, a majority of independent non-executive directors, an appropriately qualified or financially experienced independent director, and an independent chair; it also sets meeting procedures, including at least four committee meetings and two meetings with external auditors each year.

data.title: Subsidiary’s Offer Selected in Public Procurement Procedure
data.description:
MedTech Solutions S.A. ( (PL:MDT) ) has issued an announcement.

MedTech Solutions S.A.’s subsidiary, Good For You Medical sp. z o.o., submitted the most advantageous offer in a public procurement procedure conducted by 5 Wojskowy Szpital Kliniczny z Polikliniką SP ZOZ in Kraków. The contract covers a mobile surgical table with an X-ray imaging system and a mobile power generator.

The offer received the highest score based on price and warranty period, including a 48-month warranty. Its gross value was PLN 645,582.00, with the selection allowing the subsidiary to enter an agreement and carry out the delivery under the procedure’s terms.

data.title: Yueyun Announces Agreements to Repurchase Stakes in Two Subsidiaries
data.description:
Guangdong Yueyun Transportation Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:3399) ) has issued an announcement.

On 19 November 2026, Guangzhou Company agreed to repurchase Shenzhen Communication’s 19% equity interest for RMB9,802,700 and cancel it through a capital reduction. Hong Kong Company conditionally agreed to repurchase Shenzhen Communication’s 3,420 shares, representing 19% of its issued shares, for HK$119,621,500 and cancel them; aggregate consideration is approximately RMB112,154,444 at the stated exchange rate.

Upon completion, the Company’s holding in each subsidiary would rise from 62% to approximately 76.54%, Jing Mei’s would rise from 19% to approximately 23.46%, and Shenzhen Communication would no longer hold equity in either company. The subsidiaries would remain non-wholly-owned and consolidated, while the aggregated repurchases are discloseable and connected transactions subject to reporting and announcement requirements but exempt from shareholder approval.
